text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and maintaining web applications.

I’d be a strong fit for your Django ecommerce platform because I’ve worked on backend-heavy systems with PostgreSQL and Celery, and I’m comfortable collaborating on specs while also driving tasks independently. In a recent nonprofit project, I upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX; donation entry time dropped 45% with zero data loss across 180k donor records. I also built embedded usage dashboards for a B2B SaaS product using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, rolled out to 140 customer accounts and delivered 3 weeks early.

I can help maintain your current application, improve reliability, and support scaling as your product and data grow.
